description:
We are Team URUTAU from UNIFEI (Itabira, MG, Brazil). We bridge NASA Earth observations (MERRA-2), FAO EcoCrop thresholds, and USNO lunar ephemerides to build offline-resilient planting tools for family farmers in semi-arid Minas Gerais.

Our strengths include Python data engineering, agroclimatology, and Streamlit dashboards backed by real, auditable data. We welcome teammates in agronomy, remote sensing, UI/UX design, and science communication to drive real local impact!
